name: GA4GH Security Suite (Passport + Crypt4GH)
summary: Mounts the ga4gh-passport and ga4gh-crypt4gh plugins together and reports which GA4GH security-domain standards the composition bundles
description:
Meta-server mounting the `ga4gh-passport` and `ga4gh-crypt4gh` plugins together, reporting which GA4GH security-domain standards the composition bundles.

**Install**: not published to npm or any other package registry. Clone and build the `ga4gh-plugins` repository, then run this package's standalone stdio MCP server with Node, using an absolute path:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/susheel/ga4gh-plugins.git
cd ga4gh-plugins && pnpm install && pnpm run build
node /absolute/path/to/ga4gh-plugins/packages/security/lib/bin.js
```
